meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 当用户问起过往会话时,Claude 会先搜索跨会话记忆库,返回带编号的结果表供筛选;再查看相关时间线上下文;最后只获取用户选中的记录的完整详情。
howto.when: 当用户提到“这个我们是不是已经解决过”“上次是怎么做XX的”等回顾以往会话的问题,或需要用到之前会话的记录时触发。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么修复 JWT 认证过期问题的?
say.note: 会先返回带编号的记忆列表,选定后再取详情。

say.text: 这个登录 bug 之前修过吗?帮我查查。
say.note: 会按关键词搜索之前的会话记录。

say.text: 查一下上周关于认证模块的讨论。
say.note: 会先搜索,再展示相关时间线辅助定位。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about earlier sessions, Claude searches the cross-session memory database, shows an ID-tagged result list for filtering, inspects surrounding timeline context, then fetches full details only for the records chosen.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks 'did we already solve this?', 'how did we do X last time?', or needs records from previous sessions.

say_en.text: How did we fix the JWT auth expiration last time?
say_en.note: Shows IDs first; fetch details only after selection.

say_en.text: Has this login bug been fixed before? Search for it.
Find last week's discussions about the auth module.
